Key Features & Advantages

Quick-Lift Hydraulic System

Reaches maximum elevation in 10-12 strokes for swift warehouse and dock operations.

Controlled Lowering Valve

Special bypass valve enables smooth, shock-free descent with heavy pallet loads.

Reinforced Channel Steel Frame

Forged high-tensile steel frame with reinforced fork gussets and steel hangers for maximum rigidity.

Entry & Exit Guide Rollers

Nylon entry rollers under the fork tips ensure smooth gliding over pallet bottoms and ramps.

Standards & Compliance

EN ISO 3691-5:2014

Safety requirements and verification for pedestrian-propelled industrial trucks.

CE Certified

Full European conformity and proof-load verification.

Product Overview

Europull heavy-duty hand pallet trucks are engineered for intensive material handling in warehouses, distribution centers, logistics hubs, and offshore supply yards. Featuring an all-steel welded frame, leak-proof cast hydraulic unit, and ergonomic 3-position lever control.

Frequently Asked Questions

Which models of the Europull Hand Pallet Truck are available?

The Europull Hand Pallet Truck is available in 4 models: LNA25, LNA30, LNA35, QBL5. Capacity (kg) ranges from 2,500 kg to 5,000 kg (Heavy). Full figures for every model are in the technical specifications table on this page.

What capacity range does the Europull Hand Pallet Truck cover?

The Europull Hand Pallet Truck covers 2.5t - 3.5t.

Which standard does the Europull Hand Pallet Truck comply with?

The Europull Hand Pallet Truck is manufactured to EN ISO 3691-5:2014.

What hydraulic Pump does the Europull Hand Pallet Truck have?

The Europull Hand Pallet Truck's hydraulic Pump: Integrated Leak-Proof Cast Pump with Quick-Lift.

What fork Dimensions does the Europull Hand Pallet Truck have?

The Europull Hand Pallet Truck's fork Dimensions: 550 × 1150 mm / 685 × 1220 mm.

What lift Strokes does the Europull Hand Pallet Truck have?

The Europull Hand Pallet Truck's lift Strokes: Quick-Lift to Full Height in 10-12 Strokes.
